game.q: ‘adi hears about the white and black threads. what does he do?
opts: puts real threads under his pillow

wrong.alarm: relatable. but no alarms back then.
wrong.poll: sensible! but he went way more literal.

game.right: YES. two real threads under his pillow, checked all night. he couldn’t tell them apart.

end.line: a tired farmer fainted from the fast, and the night was opened: eat until the dawn shows clear.

cliff.s1: new clothes. a new crescent moon.

share: a farmer fell asleep before dinner, so the rule got gentler. one day of ramadan, on infinite hill
